name: Belgian Legal Documents (FR)
description: Belgian legal documents in French (citations, conclusions, actes). Detects the BCE company number, cadastral references (division, section, parcelle), Belgian street addresses and postal codes, company names by legal form (SRL, SA, ASBL…), IBAN, plus personal names. Amounts in € are kept visible on purpose.

patterns.name: Numéro BCE / TVA
patterns.description: Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises — 0xxx.xxx.xxx, optional BE prefix (TVA)

patterns.name: Référence cadastrale
patterns.description: Cadastral reference — division, section, parcelle/n°, context-anchored

patterns.name: Adresse (rue + numéro)
patterns.description: Belgian/French street address — street type + name + house number

patterns.name: Code postal + ville
patterns.description: Belgian 4-digit postal code followed by city name

patterns.name: Société (forme juridique)
patterns.description: Company name followed by a Belgian legal form (SRL, SA, ASBL, NV…)

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number — supports spaces between groups
